description: Backend Part 7 core: Room.lastActivityAt, RoomRepository.listOngoingForUser, server-derived ongoing status + room summary/details, GET /api/me/rooms, GET /api/rooms/:code/summary, POST /api/rooms/:code/rejoin, and ROOM_STATE additions (activity, recentBids, lastActivityAt, ongoingStatus, resumePath, manager username fallback). Independent of FEAT-002 except both touch room-state.ts/hub call sites (do FEAT-001 first). See plan.md decisions 1-3, 9, 10 and items 1-4.
steps: backend/src/domain/types.ts: add optional `lastActivityAt?: number` to Room. backend/src/modules/rooms/room.manager.ts: set it to clock.now() in create() and in mutate() right before assertRoom(draft) when events.length>0.

backend/src/repositories/interfaces.ts: add listOngoingForUser(userId): Promise<Room[]> to RoomRepository; implement in memory.ts and file.ts (status not COMPLETED/CLOSED and member) and postgres-live.ts (`where status not in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED') and exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(state->'teams') t where t->>'userId'=${userId}) order by updated_at desc`). Add the exact normalized statement to FakeLiveSql.run in backend/tests/helpers-pg-double.ts. Fix any other RoomRepository implementers reported by tsc.

Create backend/src/modules/rooms/room-summary.ts: export OngoingStatus type and roomSummary(room,userId,now,presence?) (fields: roomId, roomCode, auctionName, ongoingStatus, rawStatus, retention {phase, activeTeamName, completed, total}|null, teamCount, capacity, role {isHost, teamId, teamName}, round, category (potId), currentPlayer {id,name,position,potId,currentBidCr,highestBidderTeamName,endsAt,remainingTimeMs}|null, playersSold (non-RETENTION purchases), playersRetained, playersUnsold, playersRemaining (null while players is empty), lastActivityAt (fallback createdAt), createdAt, canContinue, resumePath) following the mapping in plan.md decision 1; and roomDetails(...) adding per-team rows (name, managerUsername, isHost, remainingBudgetCr, playersOwned, retainedCount, connected; lastSeenAt only if viewer is host). Never include players/bids/receipts arrays.

backend/src/modules/rooms/room.routes.ts: add GET /api/me/rooms ({rooms: summaries newest lastActivityAt first, serverTime}; uses manager.repository.listOngoingForUser(request.auth.userId); COMPLETED/CLOSED never returned), GET /api/rooms/:code/summary (requireMember, read-only, returns roomDetails), POST /api/rooms/:code/rejoin (strict empty body via z.object({}).strict(), rateLimit 30/min; requireMember (403 NOT_ROOM_MEMBER with message 'You are not a member of this auction. Use Join Auction Room to join a lobby.'); CLOSED -> DomainError ROOM_CLOSED 409 'This auction was cancelled.'; COMPLETED -> 200 with canContinue=false and resumePath /results/CODE; no mutation, no sequence change). Team identity only from request.auth.userId.

backend/src/modules/rooms/room-state.ts: add to roomState output `activity` (last 60 newest-first entries derived from tails of room.bids, non-retention purchases, playerHistory, retention.turns with stable ids: bid.id, purchase.id, `unsold-<playerId>-<at>`, `recalled-<playerId>-<at>`, turn.id; fields id, kind BID|SOLD|UNSOLD|RECALLED|RETENTION, at, teamId?, teamName?, playerId?, playerName?, amountCr?, detail?), `recentBids` (last 20 bids of the active player, newest first), `lastActivityAt`, `ongoingStatus`, `resumePath`, optional `teamPresence` parameter (host viewers only; added as trailing optional argument, unused until FEAT-002). Change the manager username fallback in teams and currentUserTeam to `usernames[t.userId] || t.managerUsername || ''`.

Create backend/tests/continue-rejoin.test.ts per plan.md item 4 (use fixture() from tests/helpers.ts for engine/state setup and buildApp+StaticTokenAuthService+app.inject like tests/integration.test.ts for HTTP): every status mapping row, COMPLETED/CLOSED excluded from /api/me/rooms but returned by summary/rejoin, other users' rooms excluded, summary shape has no snapshot arrays, non-member 403 on summary/rejoin, rejoin/summary leave sequence and teams unchanged, 5 parallel rejoins create no duplicate membership, rejoin rejects unknown body fields (teamId/teamName), resumePath per state, ROOM_STATE activity/recentBids restored after a manager re-create over the same repository, lastActivityAt advances on mutation and is persisted.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/me/rooms returns only the caller's rooms whose status is not COMPLETED or CLOSED, each with ongoingStatus, resumePath and the summary fields, and no snapshot arrays
COMPLETED and CLOSED rooms are never returned by /api/me/rooms; rejoin returns canContinue=false (COMPLETED) or 409 ROOM_CLOSED (CLOSED)
POST /api/rooms/:code/rejoin and GET /api/rooms/:code/summary return 403 NOT_ROOM_MEMBER for a non-member and never change room.sequence or teams
ROOM_STATE contains activity (<=60, newest first, stable ids), recentBids (<=20), lastActivityAt, ongoingStatus, resumePath
backend/tests/continue-rejoin.test.ts passes; tsc --noEmit is clean; existing tests that were green stay green
verification: cd backend; npx vitest run tests/continue-rejoin.test.ts tests/live-room-repository.test.ts tests/recovery-auth-timers.test.ts tests/retention.test.ts tests/auction.test.ts tests/integration.test.ts
findings:
Ran: `npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit` clean; `npx vitest run tests/continue-rejoin.test.ts tests/live-room-repository.test.ts tests/recovery-auth-timers.test.ts tests/retention.test.ts tests/auction.test.ts tests/integration.test.ts` -> 118 passed, 1 failed (integration.test.ts "synchronizes skip voting for host + three peers..." = known skip-vote baseline, expected required 3 got 4). continue-rejoin.test.ts: 14 tests pass (ongoing status mapping > maps every unfinished state and resume path; reports a cancelled lobby as CANCELLED; summary fields > describes the live lot without snapshot arrays / counts only auction sales as sold and keeps remaining null until the pool exists / advances and persists lastActivityAt on mutation; HTTP endpoints > lists only the caller's unfinished rooms.../returns COMPLETED rooms from summary/rejoin as view-only.../denies non-members and never mutates.../returns host details with presence.../keeps membership and sequence unchanged across five parallel rejoins.../rejects body fields...; ROOM_STATE restoration > restores activity, recentBids and lastActivityAt after the manager is re-created.../caps the feed at 60.../never sends teamPresence unless host).
Deviations: also added listOngoingForUser to the legacy PostgresRoomRepository (repositories/postgres.ts, required by tsc). Retention-status tests use real commands (START_RETENTION, SKIP_RETENTION, FINALIZE_RETENTIONS) with FC26 fixture catalog. Rejoin response is the roomSummary (not a snapshot). `/summary` presence is currently derived from hub.connectedUsers only; lastSeenAt is null until FEAT-002 supplies persisted presence (route helper `presenceOf` in room.routes.ts is the hook; roomDetails accepts presence map {userId:{connected,lastSeenAt}}).
Payload shapes:
- GET /api/me/rooms -> {rooms: RoomSummary[], serverTime}. Only status not COMPLETED/CLOSED, caller's rooms, newest lastActivityAt first.
- RoomSummary = {roomId, roomCode, auctionName, ongoingStatus: 'NOT_STARTED'|'WAITING_FOR_TEAMS'|'RETENTION_IN_PROGRESS'|'READY_TO_START'|'LIVE_AUCTION'|'PAUSED'|'COMPLETED'|'CANCELLED', rawStatus: RoomStatus, retention: null | {phase, activeTeamName: string|null, completed, total}, teamCount, capacity, role: {isHost, teamId: string|null, teamName: string|null}, round: number|null, category: string|null (potId), currentPlayer: null | {id, name, position, potId, currentBidCr, highestBidderTeamName: string|null, endsAt: number|null, remainingTimeMs: number|null}, playersSold, playersRetained, playersUnsold, playersRemaining: number|null, lastActivityAt, createdAt, canContinue, resumePath, serverTime}.
- GET /api/rooms/:code/summary -> RoomSummary & {teams: [{id, name, managerUsername, isHost, remainingBudgetCr, playersOwned, retainedCount, connected, lastSeenAt?: number|null (host viewer only)}]}. 403 NOT_ROOM_MEMBER for non-members (message 'You are not a member of this auction. Use Join Auction Room to join a lobby.'), 404 unknown code.
- POST /api/rooms/:code/rejoin (empty or {} body; extra fields -> 400) -> RoomSummary; CLOSED -> 409 ROOM_CLOSED 'This auction was cancelled.'; COMPLETED -> 200 canContinue=false resumePath /results/CODE; rate limit 30/min. Error body shape: {error:{code,message}}.
- resumePath: COMPLETED/CLOSED /results/CODE; LOBBY with retention TEAM_SELECTING|ALL_TEAMS_COMPLETED /room/CODE/retention; other LOBBY /room/CODE; STARTING/RUNNING/PAUSED /auction/CODE.
- ROOM_STATE / GET state additions: activity: [{id, kind: 'BID'|'SOLD'|'UNSOLD'|'RECALLED'|'RETENTION', at, teamId?, teamName?, playerId?, playerName?, amountCr?, detail?}] (<=60 newest first; ids bid.id/purchase.id/`unsold-<playerId>-<at>`/`recalled-<playerId>-<at>`/turn.id; RETENTION detail 'SKIPPED' or 'RETAINED:<n>', amountCr = spent; UNSOLD detail 'UNANIMOUS_SKIP' when applicable); recentBids: [{id, teamId, teamName, amountCr, at}] (<=20, active player, newest first); lastActivityAt; ongoingStatus; resumePath; teamPresence only when passed AND viewer is host.
- room-state.ts exports: roomState(room,userId,serverTime,connectedUsers=[],usernames={},teamPresence?: TeamPresenceEntry[]) with TeamPresenceEntry {teamId, connected, lastSeenAt: number|null, managerUsername}; roomActivity, recentBids, ACTIVITY_LIMIT=60, RECENT_BID_LIMIT=20. room-summary.ts exports ongoingStatus, resumePath, lastActivityOf, roomSummary(room,userId,now), roomDetails(room,userId,now,presence?: Record<userId,{connected,lastSeenAt}>). Manager username in teams/currentUserTeam = usernames[userId] || team.managerUsername || ''.
- Room.lastActivityAt set in RoomManager.create and in mutate (events>0), persisted in snapshot; no migration. RoomRepository.listOngoingForUser(userId) implemented in memory/file/postgres-live/postgres; FakeLiveSql handles the exact statement.
- hub.ts/room.routes.ts snapshot() call sites unchanged (new arg optional); FEAT-002 should pass teamPresence from hub.
